release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R37 (2026-07-30, same-day rework of R36 per Stephen's design review): bucket classification moves from business unit to JOB TYPE (BUs are unreliable — jobs land in the wrong BU). bucketOfJT order: Callback → Warranty → Non-Revenue (qci|service exception|permit|smart sadie) → Install (^(h|p)-install) → Service (everything else). The two R36 Summary cards merge into ONE approved card — columns Service / Install / Non-Revenue / Callback / Warranty; rows Jobs / Revenue / Labor (% of column revenue) / Purchases (%) / Margin ($ + %) / Erosion (= margin lost when a bucket runs negative, $0 otherwise, with % of scope net revenue; — on Service and Install). Labor + purchases are pure job-attributed sums — the invBurn/rebate revenue-share allocation is dropped from the card (both remain in the P&L); the five columns partition ALL jobs and sum to the P&L job-attributed totals. Negative dollars and percentages render red. Trends: the R36 erosion rows are REPLACED by a 'Non-Revenue · Callback · Warranty — Margin' section (nrMgn / cbMgn / wtyMgn / combined CB+WTY row; money, g:1, nosm, MTD-Pace aware via paceVals nrMgn/cbMgn/wtyMgn/cbwtMgn).
